title: Solar Panels
subtitle: Four tiers, free power from the sky
text:
A solar panel needs open sky right above it. It makes FE in daylight and gives it out of its sides and bottom.

Iron: 4 FE/t, stores 2k.
Copper: 20 FE/t, stores 10k.
Gold: 100 FE/t, stores 50k.
Diamond: 1,000 FE/t by day and 500 at night, stores 500k.

Each tier takes four panels of the tier below. The Diamond panel gives MV: use Gold Cable or an LV/MV Transformer front, or LV blocks next to it explode. Right click a panel to read it.
caption: Iron, Copper, Gold and Diamond
